records.source: Your fishing tackle has worn out.
records.translation: Nasira na ang iyong Kagamitang Pangisda.

records.source: You found a lost book. The library has been expanded.
records.translation: Nakakita ka ng Nawawalang Aklat. Nadagdagan ang aklatan.

records.source: The prismatic shard changes shape before your very eyes! This power is tremendous.^^     You've found the =Galaxy Sword=  ^
records.translation: Nagbabago ng hugis ang Prismatikong Tipak sa harap mismo ng iyong mga mata! Napakalakas ng kapangyarihang ito.^^     Nahanap mo ang =Espada ng Galaksi=  ^

records.source: The Purple Dragon danced with the Robot
